reject: why-eslint: 10.x cannot be installed by npm ci - eslint-plugin-import 2.32.0 (latest) declares a peer range that stops at eslint 9 (re-tested 2026-10-20)

why-typescript: 7.0.2 fails npm install with ERESOLVE because the ts lint parser 8.72 declares a peer range of typescript <6.1.0, and its Go-built tsgo binaries trip the Grype source scan (re-tested 2026-10-20)

why-types-node: its major must match the Node runtime major in .nvmrc (24); a higher major only weakens type checking (tsc accepts newer-Node-only APIs that crash at runtime); bump together with the runtime

why-ts-jest: 29.4.10 started honouring moduleResolution nodeNext with per-import resolutionMode, which makes namespace-style type references resolve to a package's ESM d.ts and fail with TS2503; hold at 29.4.6 until the sources use named type imports (reproduced 2026-09-18 in another repo)
